paper.title: EvolveR: Self-Evolving LLM Agents through an Experience-Driven Lifecycle
paper.central_claim: 通过在线交互、离线自蒸馏、语义去重/合并/效用剪枝的principle经验库与GRPO策略共同演化，持续积累可迁移经验，在多跳QA上超越强基线；3B自蒸馏优于外部teacher因认知对齐。

provenance.notes: Opus aggregate seat via the configured claude-kimi type fable; no route probing. actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref are null because the subagent runtime exposes no verifiable provider receipt to this worker.

sections_read: Opus: complete pinned text read end-to-end (abstract, all sections, tables, appendices) before opening seat records; targeted re-reads for every disputed field

signatures.object: 外部非权重principle库：文字描述+结构化三元组+来源轨迹+使用/成功计数
signatures.information: 当前policy在训练任务上成功/失败轨迹与EM结果
signatures.operation: 冻结当前policy生成指导/警告principle；组内等价去重；embedding预筛+LLM等价判定后add或merge；按平滑效用分周期prune
signatures.output: 更新后的持久经验库及历史效用分
signatures.conditions: 训练任务有可靠答案标签；模型能抽象非泛泛建议；语义判重不过度合并
signatures.feedback: EM最终答案、principle使用/成功计数；LLM语义等价
signatures.selection_rule: 相似阈值0.85预筛、二元等价判断；s=(success+1)/(use+2)，低于0.3周期清理
signatures.selection_data: NQ/HotpotQA训练拆分；principle效用来自其使用轨迹；非逐条独立因果验证
signatures.persistence: Milvus经验库、principle及关联轨迹/计数
signatures.later_use: 后续任务中search_experience检索top3作为context；标准方法对返回文本mask loss
signatures.claimed_effect: 跨任务复用更通用策略，抑制低效与冗余经验
signatures.failure_boundary: 单轨迹抽象、joint outcome credit、语义误合并/泛化错误；高分经验仍有错误，版本/rollback不详

signatures.object: 经验使用policy权重与经验库共同演化的接口
signatures.operation: 约700条cold-start SFT；每prompt8条rollout，GRPO学习利用外部principle；再固定policy离线写库
signatures.output: 新policy及下一轮用于蒸馏的经验轨迹
signatures.conditions: 非权重库实际被后续读取；RL与库作用可分离
signatures.feedback: EM outcome权重1.0及format权重0.1，含搜索次数/多样性bonus
signatures.selection_rule: GRPO group-relative advantage；S1库维护独立于直接权重更新
signatures.selection_data: NQ/Hotpot训练数据；非OOD测试标签训练
signatures.persistence: policy checkpoint + S1库；按A3因非权重库被单独评价而在范围内
signatures.later_use: 同policy在test阶段允许/禁止库访问形成store-off控制
signatures.claimed_effect: 学会检索有用principle，协同提升QA
signatures.failure_boundary: 额外调用/格式激励与自然语言principle效用混杂；不能仅据policy变强或幸存经验分升称improver

rs_pattern.reason: Final = sol (C03). EvolveR executes C03 more fully than retrieval-only memories: an upstream phase (cold-start SFT + GRPO with retrieved principles in context) teaches the policy to read the conditioning substrate, and generalization is tested on five held-out datasets. Held-out datasets, not task categories, and no contamination audit → fit kept 'high' only for the operation, not the evidence.

assessment.evidence_level_note: Both seats 'retained', re-checked: the principle base is built on NQ/HotpotQA training splits and read on disjoint test sets incl. five evaluation-only datasets; removing it at evaluation drops the same trained policy 0.382→0.340. Caveat: that contrast removes a store the policy was trained to depend on (opus:O11), and no recipe-matched no-store policy exists (opus:O01/O02), so the size of the retained-store effect is bounded only loosely. Not improver.
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: With an RL-trained 3B/7B policy that learned to consult it, a self-built principle base from training splits improves later held-out QA versus the same policy without access (author-reported, single runs). Superiority of the whole lifecycle over Search-R1 is confounded with a GPT-4o cold-start SFT recipe Search-R1 did not receive; self- vs teacher-distillation at 3B (0.382 vs 0.370) is within untested noise.

E.causality.reason: Shared-error correction (both seats 3 → 2). The decisive control for the central claim — the lifecycle versus RL alone under the same recipe — is not run: Table 4's 'RL only' row and Table 5's no-store row are the Search-R1 baseline average (0.325, opus:O01–O03), the 'no RL' row is the SFT-trained variant (opus:O04/O05) and the 'nothing' row is Direct Inference (opus:O06/O07). EvolveR alone gets cold-start SFT on GPT-4o-generated experience-format trajectories (opus:O09/O10) and a format reward, so the gap to Search-R1 mixes recipe and store; the store-off policy (0.340) already beats that row (opus:O12). The only in-pipeline store contrast removes the store from a policy trained to use it (opus:O11). No raw-trajectory memory or curator-off control; self vs teacher gap 0.012 single run. Real controls exist (store-off, teacher, SFT-vs-RL) → 2, not 1.

E.holdout.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked (train-split construction, five evaluation-only datasets; no contamination audit). 明确NQ/Hotpot训练拆分建库、五域只做generalization评估，store-off在后续任务成立。缺近重复审计和完整调参隔离；六benchmark validation与七test的协议边界需说明。
